title: Commitments: nothing gets lost
summary: A state machine for anything that can be lost (received, acknowledged, in_progress, done, verified, closed; plus suppressed, cancelled, breached) with dedupe key, owner seat, ack deadline and due clock; the tick wakes owners, re-escalates an unacknowledged commitment to the manager and then the CEO, and marks breaches.
enableWhen: a request, order, job or lead can be lost

tools.purpose: create, transition, list and tick commitments

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner
